data.description:
## Context / Problem
Repo-root scratch (`<repo>/bridge_state/`) is written by `fetcher.py:630-633`, `applier.py:560-563,669-672`, `apply_planning.py:341-356`, `load_phase.py:180-181,200-201`, `alert_store.py:23-28`, `dispatch_one.py:165`, `apply_inbound.py:107`, `apply_handlers.py:598`, `invariants.py:404`; it grows unbounded, sits at the repo root (bug `germinable-cosey-vireo` symptom), and `reconcile.py:150-151` falsely documents the prev snapshot there (it is `<tracker>/.bridge_state/prev_snapshot.json`, `load_phase.py:210-212`). `.gitignore:24` `.rebar/*` ignores everything under `.rebar/` with surgical un-ignores (`:25-47`), so `.rebar/bridge/` needs no new pattern and `.gitignore:14` `bridge_state/` becomes dead. `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` uses the git file list (bug `germinable-cosey-vireo`, closed); only its comment `:28` names `bridge_state/`. Tracker-side `<tracker>/.bridge_state/` (bindings, projects, prev_snapshot, last-pass) is committed state and is not renamed. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0 (engine paths are under `src/rebar/reconciler/` after the package move).

## Approach
1. New `src/rebar/reconciler/scratch_retention.py` (~120 LOC): `BRIDGE_SCRATCH_SUBDIR = Path(".rebar")/"bridge"`, `bridge_scratch_dir(repo_root)`, `snapshots_dir()`, `alerts_dir()`, `sync_log_path(repo_root, pass_id)`, `mapping_path()`, `divergence_state_path()`, constants `RETAIN_SNAPSHOT_PASSES = 5`, `RETAIN_SYNC_LOGS = 5`, `RETAIN_ALERT_DAYS = 30`, and `prune_bridge_scratch(repo_root, *, keep_passes=…, keep_logs=…, keep_alert_days=…) -> dict[str, int]` — best-effort, exception-swallowing (`logger.warning`), mirroring `llm/completion_sidecar.py:46,248-275` (`RETAIN_PER_TICKET`, `prune(keep=…)`): snapshots grouped by pass-id prefix (`<pass>.json`, `<pass>.manifest.json`, stray `<pass>.*.json.tmp`), newest-by-name (pass ids are `%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%S`, lexically ordered); `sync-log-*.jsonl` by name; `bridge_alerts/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` keeps the 30 newest files. `mapping.json` and `comment_id_divergence.json` are cross-pass state and are never pruned.
2. Every writer module imports these path helpers (`alert_store._STATE_SUBDIR` deleted).
3. Call `prune_bridge_scratch(ctx.repo_root)` in `persist_phase.persist_and_log` after `sync_logger.close()` (`:269`), guarded by `if persist:`.
4. Fix `reconcile.py:150-151`; `docs/adr/0099-binding-store-internal-ownership.md:72` row → `<repo_root>/.rebar/bridge/bridge_alerts/*.jsonl`; delete `.gitignore:14`; update the `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:28` comment; update the paths in `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`, `docs/concurrency.md`.
5. Tests: the 54 files matched by `git grep -lE '(^|[^._A-Za-z])bridge_state' origin/main -- tests` re-spell the path via the helpers, excluding `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/prose.json` (a frozen fixture that must not change) and `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py` (stays as-is). New `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_scratch_retention.py`. No migration of existing `bridge_state/` dirs (scratch; operators delete it).

BREAKING: reconciler scratch moves from `<repo>/bridge_state/` to `<repo>/.rebar/bridge/`; snapshots and sync logs keep the last 5 passes, alerts the last 30 days.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/scratch_retention.py` (new), the nine writer modules `src/rebar/reconciler/{alert_store,fetcher,applier,apply_planning,load_phase,dispatch_one,apply_inbound,apply_handlers,invariants}.py`, `src/rebar/reconciler/persist_phase.py`, `src/rebar/reconciler/reconcile.py`, `.gitignore`, `docs/adr/0099-binding-store-internal-ownership.md:72`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`, `docs/concurrency.md`, `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:28`, the tests named above. Out of scope: tracker-side `<tracker>/.bridge_state/` (committed state, not renamed), any new `.gitignore` pattern, and migration of existing scratch dirs.

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/reconciler/state tests/unit/reconciler/fetch tests/unit/reconciler/orchestrate -q`; a live-mode `reconcile_once` in a tmp repo writes under `<root>/.rebar/bridge/` and nothing under `<root>/bridge_state/`. Edge (new `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_scratch_retention.py`): seed 7 pass ids × (`.json` + `.manifest.json`) + 7 sync logs + 35 alert days → prune leaves 5/5/30 newest and returns `{"snapshots": 4, "sync_logs": 2, "alerts": 5}`; unreadable dir → returns zeros, no raise; a preview pass (`persist=False`) does not prune; `git status --porcelain` after a pass shows no untracked `.rebar/bridge` (covered by `.rebar/*`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -nE '(^|[^._A-Za-z])bridge_state' -- src scripts .gitignore` is empty — grep.
- [ ] Retention test passes with the exact counts above — `pytest tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_scratch_retention.py -q`.
- [ ] `reconcile.py` docstring names `<tracker>/.bridge_state/prev_snapshot.json` — grep.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; `make lint` exits 0 in a checkout that has run a live pass (vocabulary guard unaffected).
data.title: Move reconciler scratch from bridge_state/ to .rebar/bridge/ with keep-last-N retention
